requirement.description: The AAuthClient currently lacks support for system version 2000, raising a ValueError when this version is configured.
requirement.contract: Enable configuration of system version 2000. The client must update the User-Agent header to reflect SDK 20.5.4.0 and utilize the correct endpoint paths (e.g., /v5/challenge) associated with this version.

requirement.description: The BAASClient currently lacks support for system version 2000, raising a ValueError when this version is configured.
requirement.contract: Enable configuration of system version 2000. The client must update the User-Agent header to reflect SDK 20.5.4.0 and modify request bodies to include specific parameters required by this version (e.g., naCountry, isPersistent in login requests).

requirement.description: The DAuthClient currently lacks support for system version 2000, raising a ValueError when this version is configured.
requirement.contract: Enable configuration of system version 2000. The client must update endpoints to /v8 paths and change request body formats from form-urlencoded to JSON for token requests, along with updating the User-Agent header.

requirement.description: The DragonsClient currently lacks support for system version 2000, raising a ValueError when this version is configured.
requirement.contract: Enable configuration of system version 2000. The client must update endpoints to /v2 paths and ensure the User-Agent header reflects SDK 20.5.4.0.
